text: I've been on hold on the phone line for 40 minutes and got nowhere so I'm trying this instead. I foster a 2 year old boy and he's had a temperature of 39.1 this evening. I'm fairly sure it's his teeth, he's been dribbling non stop, soaked through two tops already, chewing on literally everything he can get his hands on including the remote and my fingers, and one cheek has gone bright red on the side where the back teeth are coming. I've done this enough times to know what teething looks like but I've also been told by the social worker that teething doesn't cause a temperature this high, so now I don't know who to believe. I just want someone to tell me if 39.1 is too high to put down to teeth and whether I should be doing something else. Would appreciate an actual reply this time.
